name: riftmap
description: See where your codebase is under pressure. Local-first repository analysis and visualization.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/git-analysis packages/analysis apps/desktop --pretty false
scripts.build: npm run engine:build && npm run --workspace @riftmap/desktop build
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run --workspace @riftmap/desktop dist
scripts.lint: tsc -b packages/shared packages/git-analysis packages/analysis apps/desktop --pretty false
